description: Content types published from the Content Type Hub. PRD F-001. Content type IDs are stable contracts and must never be regenerated once published.
idConvention: Child of Document (0x0101) as 0x010100 + GUID; sub-types append two hex digits to the parent id.

contentTypes.name: Controlled Document
contentTypes.description: Abstract base for all governed controlled documents. Not used directly in libraries; sub-types are.

contentTypes.name: SOP
contentTypes.description: Standard Operating Procedure. The MVP pilot document class.

contentTypes.name: Work Instruction
contentTypes.description: Task-level instruction subordinate to an SOP.

contentTypes.name: Controlled Form or Template
contentTypes.description: A BLANK controlled form or template. Completing it produces an Operational Record, which is a different entity with a different lifecycle and retention treatment.
contentTypes.criticalRule: A completed form MUST NOT overwrite the blank template. PRD F-003, DATA-001 versus DATA-006.

contentTypes.name: Business Operations Document
contentTypes.description: Governed operational document that is not a policy, SOP, work instruction or standard.

contentTypes.name: Operational Record
contentTypes.description: Evidence that a business activity occurred. Captured, not authored. Governed by the approved retention class, not by the document approval lifecycle.
contentTypes.criticalRule: Operational Records do not use DmsLifecycleStatus. They are governed by WF-05 capture and disposition.

contentTypes.name: External Document
contentTypes.description: Supplier, customer, legal or standards document held for reference. Not authored or approved internally; controlled for currency and applicability only.
contentTypes.mvpTreatment: P1 unless the pilot requires it. PRD section 10.2.

contentTypes.name: Controlled Case File
contentTypes.description: Document Set for approved case-file or multi-document work products.
contentTypes.mvpTreatment: P1. Not provisioned unless ADR approves it. PRD F-030.
